one_line: Kerala school astronomer-mathematician of the 14th–15th century, linked with Sangamagrama near the Nila–Kunti confluence.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, lean but sturdy, with the calm bearing of a seasoned scholar.
appearance.face: Oval face, warm medium-brown Kerala complexion, sharp thoughtful eyes, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, default expression a gentle, focused half-smile as if pondering a calculation.
appearance.hair: Straight, black hair gathered into a modest low bun at the back of the head; simple off-white cloth headband tied around the forehead with the knot at the back, no elaborate crown or turban.
appearance.costume: Kerala-style scholar’s attire: an unbleached off-white cotton upper cloth (veshti-like angavastram) draped securely over both shoulders and across the torso, paired with a cream-colored ankle-length dhoti with a thin maroon border wrapped tightly and neatly, the dhoti pleated in front for easy movement; a simple waist cord visible above the dhoti, and a narrow maroon shawl folded over his left shoulder; feet in plain brown leather sandals; minimal jewelry limited to a thin gold chain and a single small gold stud in each ear, plus a subtle sandalwood tilak line on his forehead.
appearance.signature: A long, rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a dark cord, with a smooth wooden stylus held lightly in his right hand.

ref_desc: Madhava of Sangamagrama is a lean, mid-40s Kerala scholar with a short beard, low-bun black hair and off-white headband, dressed in off-white upper cloth, cream dhoti with maroon border and shawl, holding a tied palm-leaf manuscript and wooden stylus in maroon-brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Madhava of Sangamagrama: a lean, mid-40s Kerala astronomer-mathematician with an oval medium-brown face, sharp thoughtful eyes, straight nose, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, wearing his straight black hair in a modest low bun secured by a simple off-white cloth headband tied around the forehead. He is fully and modestly clothed in era-accurate Kerala scholar attire: an unbleached off-white cotton upper cloth draped over both shoulders and across his torso, a cream-colored ankle-length dhoti with a thin maroon border wrapped tightly and neatly with front pleats, a visible simple waist cord, and a narrow maroon shawl folded over his left shoulder, with plain brown leather sandals on his feet, a thin gold chain at his neck, small gold studs in his ears, and a subtle sandalwood tilak line on his forehead. His signature prop is a long rolled bundle of palm-leaf manuscripts tied with a dark cord, while he lightly holds a smooth wooden stylus in his right hand. Use an anime shonen visual energy but keep the costume and props historically grounded, emphasizing the off-white, cream, maroon, brown and deep brown (#3b2a1a) palette, and show him from multiple angles to clearly display his face, low-bun hair with headband, draped upper cloth, dhoti with maroon border, shawl, sandals, and palm-leaf manuscript with stylus.
